assertions.subject: Calcinosis cutis
assertions.quote: Calcinosis cutis occurs when calcium salts are deposited into the skin and subcutaneous tissue

assertions.subject: Dystrophic calcification
assertions.quote: Dystrophic calcification is the most common cause of calcinosis cutis and is associated with normal calcium and phosphorus levels

assertions.subject: Dystrophic calcification
assertions.quote: Dystrophic calcification is typically associated with a systemic disease

assertions.subject: Metastatic calcification
assertions.predicate: abnormal serum calcium and phosphorus levels
assertions.quote: Metastatic calcification is associated with abnormal serum calcium and phosphorus levels

assertions.subject: Metastatic calcification
assertions.quote: Metastatic calcification is associated with abnormal serum calcium and phosphorus levels, and deposition occurs when calcium phosphate production exceeds a certain value

assertions.subject: Idiopathic calcification
assertions.quote: Idiopathic calcification does not involve underlying tissue damage

assertions.subject: Idiopathic calcification
assertions.quote: Idiopathic calcification does not involve underlying tissue damage or abnormal laboratory values

assertions.subject: Iatrogenic calcification
assertions.quote: Iatrogenic calcification is caused by administration of calcium or phosphate containing agents

assertions.subject: Calciphylaxis
assertions.predicate: calcification of small and medium-sized vessels
assertions.quote: Calciphylaxis involves calcification of small and medium-sized vessels

assertions.subject: Calciphylaxis
assertions.quote: Calciphylaxis involves calcification of small and medium-sized vessels and is associated with chronic renal failure and dialysis

assertions.subject: Calcinosis circumscripta
assertions.predicate: limited to an extremity or joint
assertions.quote: The disorder is classified as calcinosis circumscripta if it is limited to an extremity or joint

assertions.subject: Calcinosis universalis
assertions.predicate: diffuse involvement of subcutaneous and fibrous structures of muscles and tendons
assertions.quote: Calcinosis universalis occurs when there is diffuse involvement of subcutaneous and fibrous structures of muscles and tendons
